profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer with proven ability to learn and adapt. Developed organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills from volunteer projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• joined WhatsApp Business Platforms team
• helped implement WhatsApp Events Joiner
• joined WhatsApp Business Cloud API Messaging team
• implemented one-time prekey deprecation
• migrated incoming receipts from non-platformized path to platformized path

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
• hired as project manager of Mash, an open-source toolkit for streaming audio/video
• implemented H.263 video codec
• improved compatibility with 6 versions of Windows
• built and released binary and source code distributions
• managed CVS repository, mailing lists, and SourceForge project
• tested operating system and hardware compatibility
• mentored college students

positions.title: President
positions.description:
• designed and developed Connections, a Macintosh program for creating diagrams from databases
• implemented recently published graph layout algorithms
• wrote user manual
• managed alpha and beta testing
• founded Lim Unlimited to support and market Connections

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• joined team developing Molecular Analyst, a MacApp-based image analysis program
• implemented scan preview display
• developed user interface for calibrating densitometers
• tested, translated, and refined lane-finding and band-finding algorithms

positions.title: Postgraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• developed chess program for artificial intelligence research
• implemented, tested, and analyzed new game-playing algorithms

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• joined development team for Dreams, a Macintosh CAD program
• wrote code for area calculations, dimensions, and keyboard resizing and positioning of objects
• increased speed of beziergon area calculations by an order of magnitude
• created Dreams installer
• managed shell for MacDraft-to-Dreams file converter
• tested for quality assurance

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
• improved the Interactive Linear Controls Analysis Program
• added bode asymptote generator, bode root loci generator, and transfer function scalers
• overhauled graphics and plotting
• standardized the user interface

volunteerExperiences.description:
• organized annual elementary school concert with 390 students singing
• recruited and supervised 75 teacher and parent volunteers
• managed audience of 1090 in two seatings
• live streamed concert to parents as far away as Venice, Italy
• handled major and minor setbacks that occurred

• founded local Pokémon Go group that has grown to over 800 players
• established policies to protect minors
• organized regular meetups and contests
• known as one of the friendliest and most cohesive groups in the Bay Area

publications.title: Analysis of a New Search Algorithm for Two-Player Games
Solving the Processor Identity Problem in O(n) Space
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the Second IEEE Symposium on Parallel and Distributed Processing · Jan 1, 1990
